notes: SSE tail of one session's events. The web app follows `/api/v1/sessions/{key}/follow` instead (one reader per log); this route is the API surface for external clients that poll a session's event stream.
Deployment-wide token usage. The web app reads the per-session usage (`GET /api/v1/sessions/{key}/usage`); this one serves operators, not the chat page.

Explicit session creation. The web app lets the server mint the session on the first turn (`POST /api/v1/chat/sessions/{key}/messages` creates it on demand), so the web client never calls this route; external clients may.
Full-text search over session logs. The web app searches the unified index (`GET /api/v1/search`); this route is the session-scoped variant for API clients.
Attachment store upload (`kind = "attachment_ref"` payloads). The web composer sends attachment bytes inline with the turn; the store's own API is for clients that upload first and reference later.
Attachment store read-back. The web composer keeps the bytes in the turn, so it never reads the store.
Attachment store delete. The web composer keeps the bytes in the turn, so it never deletes from the store.
The R29 operation endpoint, mounted only when `[operations] enabled = true`. The web client uses the chat message route; the operation wire is for clients that drive the gated operation surface.
Liveness probe for orchestrators. The web app polls `/api/health`.
Build identity for probes and clients. The web app reads its version from the bundle, not from this route.
Prometheus metrics. Scraped by operators, never by the web app.
Anthropic-compatible surface for external Anthropic clients (the web app uses `/api/v1/chat/*`).
